en: A standard adult bicycle wheel has a diameter of about 66 centimeters, acting as a large wheel and axle to multiply your pedaling force.
The coefficient of friction between ice and steel is only 0.03, which is why ice skates glide so easily across a frozen rink.
If your weight is 60 pounds on Earth, you would weigh only 10 pounds on the Moon due to its weaker gravity.
A small neodymium magnet weighing just 1 gram can generate enough magnetic force to lift up to 1 kilogram of heavy iron objects.
While electrical energy travels near the speed of light, the actual electrons inside a copper wire drift at about 1 millimeter per second.
Light travels from the Sun to Earth at 300,000 kilometers per second, taking exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to cross the 150-million-kilometer distance.
Sound waves travel through air at 343 meters per second, meaning thunder from a lightning strike 1 kilometer away takes about 3 seconds to reach you.
The visible surface of our Sun has an average temperature of about 5,500 degrees Celsius, which is hot enough to vaporize solid iron.
Because kinetic energy increases with speed squared, a car at 60 km/h has four times more energy than the same car at 30 km/h.
In a first-class lever, making the effort arm three times longer than the load arm lets you lift a heavy object using only one-third of the force.
To completely escape Earth's gravitational pull, a rocket must reach an escape velocity of 11.2 kilometers per second, or about 40,000 kilometers per hour.
A large industrial electromagnet used in a scrap yard can generate enough magnetic force to lift an entire crushed car weighing over 1,500 kilograms.
